record.title: Preserve the intermediate setup mapping rejection
record.intent: Identify the exact mapping rejected after observer removal without relaxing any mapping or reader check.
requirements: Commit and push tasking before implementation. Preserve both previous negative runs and unchanged stock inputs and reader build06.

Capture complete bounded raw process maps before parsing each setup checkpoint and include the rejected row and arithmetic values in any error. Preserve attachments before acknowledging terminal failure.

Run one fresh disposable control with unchanged restoration and reader predicates. Do not change mapping selection, permissions beyond already admitted restoration, policy, credentials, or backend in response to failure.

Classify the raw mapping evidence independently. If it explains a fixture defect, record the exact bounded successor; if the current control succeeds, verify all restored bytes/maps and detached reader evidence before claiming success.
No physical specimen contact or acquired keys. Stop on first unexpected failure and preserve journals, hashes, guest health and cleanup.
acceptance: The exact rejected mapping or fully verified successful control is preserved.
